login.title: Log in
login.description: Welcome back. Use the email you signed up with.
login.expired: Your session ended. Log in again to continue.

signup.title: Create your account
signup.description: It takes a minute. You pay only when you book.
signup.name: Full name
signup.phoneHint: Your professional sees it only during a booking.
signup.passwordHint: At least 8 characters. A few unrelated words work well.
signup.consent: By creating an account you agree to our <terms>Terms</terms> and <privacy>Privacy Policy</privacy>.

forgot.title: Forgot your password?
forgot.description: Enter your email and we'll send you a link to choose a new one.
forgot.sentBody: If an account exists for {{email}}, we've sent a link to reset your password. It works for 30 minutes.
forgot.sentHint: Nothing yet? Check your spam folder, or try again in a few minutes.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.description: You'll be logged in straight after.
reset.setDescription: Welcome. Set a password to open your panel.
reset.passwordHint: At least 8 characters. A few unrelated words work well.
reset.usedTitle: This link has already been used
reset.invalidBody: Links work once and expire after 30 minutes. Request a new one and we'll email it straight away.
